n8dd63ed271.headline: Goldman Sachs beats profit estimates, weak fixed income trading drags down shares
n8dd63ed271.summary: Goldman Sachs beat quarterly profit expectations on strength in dealmaking and equities trading. Its shares fell 1.9% on weakness in fixed income trading.
n8dd63ed271.why: Goldman Sachs is a major global investment bank whose results reflect dealmaking, trading and advisory activity. Its quarterly figures are watched as a read on Wall Street conditions.

impacts.name: Goldman Sachs
impacts.why: Shares fell 1.9% despite the profit beat, as weak fixed income trading offset strength elsewhere.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n8dd63ed271.why_moved: Shares fell 1.9% after the profit beat because weak fixed income trading offset strength in dealmaking and equities.

n117ad8a12e.headline: Multimillion-dollar fuel campaign 'sensible', PM says
n117ad8a12e.summary: The Australian federal government is running a $20 million advertising campaign urging people to cut back on fuel use. The prime minister has described the campaign as sensible.
n117ad8a12e.why: Government demand-restraint measures are used to ease pressure on fuel supplies and prices. Fuel costs feed into transport, inflation and business expenses.

n7f93ab12ac.headline: Energy shock from Middle East unrest fuels petrochemical rally in Taiwan
n7f93ab12ac.summary: Rising US-Iran tensions in late February drove a sharp rally in crude and petrochemical feedstock prices, including ethylene and propylene. Customers rebuilt inventories, boosting Taiwan's first-quarter revenues.
n7f93ab12ac.why: Petrochemicals link oil prices to plastics and chemicals manufacturing, and Taiwan is a major producer in this chain.

n19eb986ae8.headline: Malaga road projects in limbo as Madrid blocks 393m-euro infrastructure plan
n19eb986ae8.summary: Spain's Ministry of Transport rejected Malaga city council's 393 million euro infrastructure proposal. It is demanding a 20-year traffic study covering the A-7 and ring roads.
n19eb986ae8.why: Large public infrastructure plans drive construction contracts and regional investment, and their delays affect the sector.

na759137a05.headline: US says to begin blockade of Iranian ports
na759137a05.summary: The US military said it would begin a blockade of all Iranian ports on Monday, after talks between the warring sides in Pakistan collapsed. The article reports the move was made despite the talks.
na759137a05.why: Iran is a major oil exporter, and disruptions to its ports affect global crude supply and shipping routes. Investors track such moves closely for energy prices and risk sentiment.
na759137a05.why_moved: The blockade follows the collapse of talks between the warring sides, raising the risk of prolonged disruption to Gulf oil flows. Such supply risk typically lifts energy prices.

n55742ca96c.headline: Acrophyte Hospitality Trust’s ability to stay afloat in doubt over US$198.5 million loan due in September
n55742ca96c.summary: Acrophyte Hospitality Trust's ability to stay afloat is in doubt over a US$198.5 million loan due in September. Refinancing talks and due diligence are expected only closer to the maturity date.
n55742ca96c.why: Hospitality trusts own hotels and fund them with debt, so refinancing risk on large maturities can affect unit values and distributions.

n1afac887cb.headline: Hungarian Prime Minister Orbán is ejected after 16 years in a European electoral earthquake
n1afac887cb.summary: Hungarian voters on Sunday ousted long-serving Prime Minister Viktor Orbán after 16 years in power, according to AP. The vote rejected his authoritarian policies and far-right movement.
n1afac887cb.why: Hungary is an EU member whose government policy on EU funds, energy and the forint currency affects investors in Central Europe.

n965ac9612c.headline: Australia And Singapore “Good Neighbours” in Good and Bad Times
n965ac9612c.summary: Australia and Singapore have signed a bilateral agreement to keep fuel supplies flowing during the crisis. The agreement is framed as mutual support in difficult times.
n965ac9612c.why: Singapore is a major refining and fuel trading hub in Asia, so its supply arrangements affect regional fuel availability.

ne365e4e117.headline: Retail Inflation Rises To 3.4% In March, Food Prices Push CPI Higher From February’s 3.21%
ne365e4e117.summary: Retail inflation in India rose to 3.4% in March from 3.21% in February, driven mainly by food. Food inflation increased to 3.87%, and rural inflation stayed above urban levels.
ne365e4e117.why: Consumer price inflation is a key input for the Reserve Bank of India when setting interest rates, which affects bond yields and the rupee.

n605496b4fa.headline: Trump vows to sink Iranian ships approaching a U.S. blockade of Strait of Hormuz
n605496b4fa.summary: President Trump said the US would interdict vessels that had paid what he called an 'illegal toll' to Iran to cross the Strait of Hormuz.
n605496b4fa.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so shipping restrictions there quickly affect crude prices.
n605496b4fa.why_moved: A threatened US blockade of the Strait and the tolling of vessels by Iran raise the risk of disrupted tanker traffic through the chokepoint.

n8b6bc88580.headline: Iran threatens ports as US set to impose blockade
n8b6bc88580.summary: The US is preparing a blockade of all Iranian ports, and Iran has warned of a response. A showdown is looming, according to the report.
n8b6bc88580.why: Iranian ports handle a large share of the country's oil and trade flows. Blockades and port threats affect global crude supply and shipping routes.
n8b6bc88580.why_moved: The planned US blockade of Iranian ports and Iranian threats against ports raise the risk of supply disruption.

n0712480f02.headline: Floods, Fuel Shocks, and a Gulf War: Why Sri Lanka Is Running Out of Time
n0712480f02.summary: Cyclone Ditwah left Sri Lanka in ruins, and the economic shockwaves of the Iran war are threatening its recovery. Fuel shocks are adding to the pressure.
n0712480f02.why: Sri Lanka is a fuel-importing emerging economy, so energy price shocks and disaster costs strain its public finances and external position.

n78fa4d793b.headline: Resources minister defends gas companies amid tax push
n78fa4d793b.summary: The gas lobby says a new levy on LNG exports would make Australia uninvestable. The resources minister defended gas companies amid the government's tax push.
n78fa4d793b.why: Australia is a major global LNG exporter, so tax changes on exports affect gas project investment and global LNG supply.

nd563594b94.headline: NZ's top exporters call on Parliament to back FTA with India
nd563594b94.summary: New Zealand's top exporters have written to Parliament urging it to back the FTA with India, calling it a strategic necessity. NZ First disagrees with the agreement.
nd563594b94.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and shape market access for exporters, making them significant for trade-dependent economies such as New Zealand.

n75bb39244e.headline: Ghana: Afreximbank Group Delivers Strong in Results in 2025
n75bb39244e.summary: The African Export-Import Bank Group posted strong results for 2025, underscoring sustained financial resilience, increased market confidence and strategic execution.
n75bb39244e.why: Afreximbank is a multilateral lender financing African trade, and its results indicate the health of trade finance across the continent.

n55bd0fc7fc.headline: OCBC sees upside in SGX small and mid-caps on Singapore growth tailwinds despite Middle East tensions
n55bd0fc7fc.summary: OCBC sees upside in Singapore Exchange small and mid-cap stocks on growth tailwinds despite Middle East tensions. Turnover across SMID stocks has improved, most notably after the EQDP asset manager announcement.
n55bd0fc7fc.why: The Singapore Exchange is the city-state's main listing venue, and small and mid-cap segments indicate local market depth. OCBC is one of Singapore's largest banks.

n3e91ddafc8.headline: ‘Boring’ is the new black: The stars are aligning for a Singapore stock market revival
n3e91ddafc8.summary: The benchmark Straits Times Index has outperformed the S&P 500 in both US dollar and Singapore dollar terms in recent years, according to The Business Times.
n3e91ddafc8.why: The Straits Times Index tracks the largest companies listed on the Singapore Exchange and is the main benchmark for the city-state's equity market.

n494ab022b1.headline: Sensex, Nifty plunge 1 pc as US-Iran talks collapse, fuelling West Asia conflict fears
n494ab022b1.summary: Sensex and Nifty closed nearly 1% lower on Monday after US-Iran talks collapsed, fuelling fears of a wider West Asia conflict.
n494ab022b1.why: The Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking 30 large Indian companies. Its moves reflect shifts in domestic and foreign investor sentiment toward India.
n494ab022b1.why_moved: The collapse of US-Iran talks raised fears of a wider West Asia conflict, which weighed on Indian stocks at the close on Monday.

n9348dea8ac.headline: Thailand's Cabinet Approves 2027 Budget to Combat Economic Volatility
n9348dea8ac.summary: Thailand's cabinet has approved an accelerated financial roadmap for the 2027 fiscal year, signalling a major policy shift to address economic volatility.
n9348dea8ac.why: Government budgets set public spending and fiscal deficits, which influence growth, bond supply and investor sentiment in the country.

nf88e698689.headline: Philippine President Marcos suspends taxes on fuel products
nf88e698689.summary: President Marcos suspended taxes on fuel products temporarily. The reduction cuts LPG prices by 3.36 pesos per kilogram.
nf88e698689.why: Fuel taxes and LPG prices directly affect household energy costs and inflation in the Philippines, an import-dependent economy.

n3e307c3ab8.headline: Trump announces US naval blockade deepening insurance crisis
n3e307c3ab8.summary: The US decision to blockade Iranian ports and interdict ships that have paid passage tolls adds legal and underwriting complexity to an already complex insurance market.
n3e307c3ab8.why: Marine insurers price war and sanctions risk on shipping through Gulf waters, so new blockade rules raise premiums and can limit available cover.

ne944fb0bdf.headline: Oil prices surge again
ne944fb0bdf.summary: Global oil prices rose sharply again, with a barrel surpassing $100, after US President Donald Trump ordered a blockade on the Strait of Hormuz. The move follows the earlier easing of prices.
ne944fb0bdf.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so disruption there sharply affects crude prices, inflation and energy-importing economies.
ne944fb0bdf.why_moved: A US order to blockade the Strait of Hormuz raised fears of disrupted oil supply, pushing prices back above $100 a barrel.

ncfa72458b8.headline: Singapore may tighten monetary policy as oil shock lifts prices
ncfa72458b8.summary: The Singapore dollar has slipped against the US dollar since the Iran war began, and the central bank may tighten monetary policy as the oil shock lifts prices.
ncfa72458b8.why: The Monetary Authority of Singapore manages policy through the exchange rate rather than interest rates, so tightening usually means a stronger Singapore dollar. Singapore is a major trade and financial hub.

impacts.name: Singapore dollar
impacts.why: Possible monetary tightening would support the currency, though it has weakened since the war began.

n4b2015abaa.headline: China's exports set to lose momentum as Iran war undercuts AI-driven boom
n4b2015abaa.summary: China's export growth likely slowed in March as buyers chasing AI-driven demand confronted the effects of the Middle East war, according to Reuters.
n4b2015abaa.why: China is the world's largest exporter, so its trade data signal global demand and supply chain health. AI-related hardware demand has been a key driver of recent growth.

n54fb63d653.headline: Philippines Orders Meta to Tighten Measures Against 'Panic-Inducing' Fake News
n54fb63d653.summary: The Philippines government has ordered Facebook's parent Meta to curb false, panic-inducing content on its platforms. The content includes misleading claims around exaggerated oil prices.
n54fb63d653.why: Meta Platforms operates Facebook and Instagram, and regulatory orders on content can carry compliance costs and policy risks.

na60e4c2cb7.headline: Stocks, peso weaken on renewed Middle East tensions
na60e4c2cb7.summary: The local stock market fell sharply and the peso weakened back to around 60 per US dollar as renewed Middle East tensions intensified selling pressure.
na60e4c2cb7.why: The Philippine Stock Exchange index tracks the country's largest listed firms. The peso's exchange rate affects import costs and inflation for an economy dependent on imported fuel.
na60e4c2cb7.why_moved: Renewed Middle East tensions intensified selling pressure, according to the report.

nbad39bcb68.headline: Week ahead: Goldman Sachs kicks off earnings as Iran, oil tensions linger
nbad39bcb68.summary: Wall Street enters one of the busiest weeks of the quarter as earnings season begins with Goldman Sachs, alongside fresh inflation data and ongoing Iran and oil tensions.
nbad39bcb68.why: Goldman Sachs is a major global investment bank, and its quarterly results are an early read on the health of US financial markets and dealmaking.

ndf80000648.headline: Malaysia detains two tankers suspected of illegally transferring diesel
ndf80000648.summary: Malaysian authorities detained two tankers suspected of illegally transferring diesel. The waters off the country are a known site of illegal ship-to-ship transfers.
ndf80000648.why: Illegal ship-to-ship fuel transfers evade taxes and sanctions and distort regional refined product trade, drawing scrutiny from shipping and energy markets.

n500b16cefa.headline: Starbucks upgraded by Jefferies as US stabilizes, China exposure shifts
n500b16cefa.summary: Jefferies upgraded Starbucks to Hold from Underperform, citing improving visibility in its US turnaround and reduced China exposure.
n500b16cefa.why: Starbucks is a global coffee chain, and analyst rating changes can shift investor sentiment on its turnaround progress and exposure to China.

n44dcdf3d99.headline: ‘Poison pill’ shields Piki from ouster – Lopez majority
n44dcdf3d99.summary: The Lopez family majority says a poison pill in First Gen's P62-billion hydropower deal with Prime Infrastructure shields Federico Lopez from ouster.
n44dcdf3d99.why: First Gen is a Philippine power company with hydropower and gas assets. Governance disputes and large deals can affect its share price and strategic direction.

n3e70b05080.headline: Record sales drive up Axelum profit in 2025
n3e70b05080.summary: Axelum Resources grew its income in 2025 on record sales from both its international and local markets, according to the report.
n3e70b05080.why: Axelum Resources is a Philippine mining company, and its earnings reflect commodity sales and export demand.

nd6a7f01123.headline: Despite Middle East crisis, 7-Eleven on track with 5,000th store
nd6a7f01123.summary: Philippine Seven, the exclusive 7-Eleven licensee in the Philippines, remains on an aggressive expansion path despite Middle East tensions, nearing its 5,000th store.
nd6a7f01123.why: Philippine Seven operates 7-Eleven stores in the Philippines and is a major convenience retail chain. Its expansion reflects consumer spending trends.

n431c7a9fb5.headline: Germany to cut fuel taxes amid Iran war energy shock
n431c7a9fb5.summary: Germany plans to reduce fuel taxes to ease the financial burden on households facing an energy shock caused by the Middle East conflict.
n431c7a9fb5.why: Germany is Europe's largest economy, and energy cost shocks can affect inflation, consumer spending, and economic growth.
n431c7a9fb5.why_moved: The tax cut aims to mitigate the impact of rising energy costs on consumers, potentially influencing inflation and economic growth expectations in Germany.

n770c61e127.headline: China’s credit growth disappoints as weak loan demand persists
n770c61e127.summary: Despite recent improvements, China's consumer confidence remains well below pre-2022 levels, contributing to weak loan demand and disappointing credit growth.
n770c61e127.why: Credit growth is a key indicator of economic activity in China, the world's second-largest economy, influencing global markets and commodity demand.
n770c61e127.why_moved: Disappointing credit growth and weak loan demand indicate slower economic momentum in China, affecting global growth expectations.
